phase: Frozen before retrieval or generation; all source references preselected from actual chunks.
limitations: New hand-authored questions from the same five papers, with correlated/overlapping evidence; not external blind data.

retrieval.auxiliary: One fresh decomposition per answerable question; rewriting disabled to match main.py. No Gold/reference points in prompts.

grounding.positive_control: Curated actual Gold passages, explicitly oracle evidence; does not claim end-to-end retrieval answers. n11 Gold empty.
grounding.closed_book: Own-knowledge instruction differs intentionally from evidence-only instruction; measures parametric factual baseline.
grounding.evidence_controls: Gold vs irrelevant use identical evidence-only prompt. No citation repair or LLM judge. Evaluate factual points, citation support and refusal manually.

bounded_optimization.candidate_A: Reorder the already selected set by RRF votes from global CE ranking, original RRF ranking and per-subquery local evidence ranks; k=60 fixed.
bounded_optimization.candidate_B: Original retrieval first hit, then subquery first hits, then remaining selected passages in global CE order.
bounded_optimization.adoption_gate: Same selected IDs/Recall@10; new ten answerable questions MAP improves at least .03 and MRR at least .02; each old regression dataset MAP and MRR decline no more than .01. If neither qualifies, retain baseline.
bounded_optimization.cost_cap: Ten new decomposition calls plus twelve controlled answer calls; ranking probes fully offline, no repeated sampling.
bounded_optimization.cross_guard_before_probes: New cross-document MAP and MRR must not decline.

pre_run_review: Before any model call, scoring points made literal to question scope: no required unasked long-query truncation or dimension detail.

metadata_followup.reason: Positive controls n05/n08 lacked source titles; model explicitly denied paper identity despite correct passages. main.build_context also omitted existing title metadata.
metadata_followup.change: Add real existing paper title to source header; keep raw passages, question, Gold, model and evidence policy fixed.
metadata_followup.scope: Targeted positive-control replay only. Initial 12 outputs retained as primary experiment; do not claim a fresh full matrix.
